description: Fair-use ledger of the production monitor on the self-hosted server in its first live minutes, read from GET /api/receivers/health and GET /api/sources. Each receiver is grouped by the host actually contacted (from the recorded failure, else the public directory). Counts use each receiver's last outcome, so a receiver refused twice counts once.
